title: Mobile-first offline-capable on-device video editor PWA (replace Teen Patti UI)

requirements.summary: Replace the Teen Patti primary UI with a mobile-first on-device video editor home screen (English-only, no uploads).
acceptanceCriteria: Launching the app shows a video editor home screen (not the Teen Patti game)
The app supports selecting a video file from the device and previews it in-app
All processing is local in the browser (no network requests are required to edit a video)
All user-facing text in the new video editor UI is in English

file_operations.description: Replace Teen Patti shell rendering with the new video editor experience, including updated header title and wiring for Help/About dialog access. Use shadcn-ui Dialog and Button to keep the app chrome consistent; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create the main mobile-first editor screen: local file picker, in-app preview, and editor controls container. Use shadcn-ui Button, Card, and other existing UI primitives for a cohesive app-like layout; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a React hook to manage local video file selection, object URL creation/revocation, and extraction of basic metadata (duration) from an in-browser preview element, ensuring no uploads/network calls.

Refit this component into a non-blocking offline status banner (or a reusable connectivity notice) appropriate for an offline-capable editor (must not prevent editing local videos). Use shadcn-ui Card/Button styles as needed; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Implement a basic phone-friendly editing workflow: import, trim start/end, mute/unmute, and export as downloadable video with failure handling.
acceptanceCriteria: User can pick a local video file and see duration + a preview
User can set trim start and trim end (with validation: start < end, within duration)
User can toggle audio mute for the exported result
User can export and receive a downloadable edited video file (or a clearly labeled export result)
If export fails (unsupported browser/device), the app shows an English error message and a retry action

file_operations.description: Create trim UI controls optimized for mobile (start/end inputs and/or sliders) and show validation feedback. Use shadcn-ui Input, Slider, and Alert for consistent interaction patterns; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a mute/unmute toggle for export settings and show the current audio export state. Use shadcn-ui Switch (or Checkbox) and Label; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create an export panel with progress/state UI, a download action for the exported file, and clear English error + retry on failure. Use shadcn-ui Button, Progress, and Alert; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement on-device export logic (trim + optional mute) that produces a downloadable video Blob. Prefer browser-native capabilities when possible; if relying on a bundled WASM transcoder, ensure it runs fully client-side and does not require network calls during editing.

Wire import -> preview -> trim/mute settings -> export flow together; display duration and enforce trim validation (start < end, within duration). Use shadcn-ui layout primitives for mobile spacing and clear hierarchy; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add an in-app Help/About dialog explaining local-only editing, no uploads, and PWA installation steps (English).
acceptanceCriteria: Help/About content is updated to video-editor context (no Teen Patti/game/online-only text)
Help/About states in English that the app edits locally on the device and does not upload videos
Help/About includes short, correct PWA install instructions (English)

file_operations.description: Rewrite Help/About content for the video editor: clearly state local on-device processing, no uploads, privacy note, and brief install-to-home-screen instructions. Ensure all text is English and remove any game/online-only/payment content. Use shadcn-ui Alert for readable sections; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update dialog title/description and wording to match the video editor product and installation steps (English). Keep instructions accurate for common mobile browsers. Use shadcn-ui Dialog/Button as currently structured; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure Help/About entry point remains available from the new editor header (icon button) and that dialog titles/descriptions match the video editor context. Use shadcn-ui DialogTrigger/Button; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Update app chrome and PWA metadata (title, description, favicon/icons, manifest) to the new video editor product.
acceptanceCriteria: Header title is updated to an English name for the video editor (no 'Teen Patti')
frontend/index.html <title> and description reflect the video editor
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest reflects the video editor name/description and uses the new icon files
The installed PWA name on Android matches the updated manifest

file_operations.description: Update meta title/description/application-name/apple-mobile-web-app-title and icon links to the new video editor product. Wire favicon/apple-touch-icon to the generated icon assets at frontend/public/assets/generated/video-editor-icon.dim_256x256.png.

Update name/short_name/description/categories/theme colors and icon entries to use the generated video editor icons: frontend/public/assets/generated/video-editor-icon.dim_256x256.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/video-editor-icon-maskable.dim_256x256.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/video-editor-icon.dim_192x192.png.
Add the generated app icon asset and ensure it is referenced by index.html and manifest.webmanifest exactly as frontend/public/assets/generated/video-editor-icon.dim_256x256.png.
Add the generated maskable app icon asset and ensure it is referenced by manifest.webmanifest exactly as frontend/public/assets/generated/video-editor-icon-maskable.dim_256x256.png.
Add the generated 192x192 app icon asset and ensure it is referenced by manifest.webmanifest exactly as frontend/public/assets/generated/video-editor-icon.dim_192x192.png.

Update in-app header title and iconography to match the new English video editor name (remove any Teen Patti/game imagery). Use shadcn-ui Button for header actions; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Adjust service worker and offline behavior so the editor app shell works offline after first load and local editing does not require connectivity.
acceptanceCriteria: After visiting once, the PWA can be opened while offline and shows the editor UI (not only offline.html)
Offline editing works for local videos without requiring network connectivity
If a required asset is missing in offline mode, the app shows a clear English message and a retry option when online

file_operations.description: Update caching strategy for an offline-capable editor shell: pre-cache core app shell assets and serve the app shell for navigation requests when offline (so the editor UI loads, not only offline.html). Update cache name/version and cached asset list to match the new product icons.
Update offline fallback copy to the video editor context (English) and include a clear retry action. Ensure messaging does not claim the app requires internet for editing.

Add offline-aware UI messaging for missing required assets/runtime limitations: show a clear English message and a retry action when the app detects an unavailable editor capability or failed export while offline/low-resource.
Ensure the online/offline hook supports non-blocking editor UX (signal status changes and enable retry UI) without forcing an online requirement for local editing.

requirements.summary: Apply a coherent non-blue/purple default visual theme suitable for a clean mobile video editor and use it consistently across screens and dialogs.
acceptanceCriteria: Primary/secondary buttons and dialog surfaces look consistent and app-like on mobile
No default blue/purple-dominant palette is introduced unless already present; keep styling cohesive and modern
The layout is mobile-first with no horizontal scrolling on common phone sizes

file_operations.description: Adjust global theme tokens (OKLCH variables), surfaces, and shared utility classes to a clean editor aesthetic (non-blue/purple dominant), ensuring consistent buttons/dialog surfaces and mobile-first spacing without horizontal scrolling.

Update dialog wrapper styling class names/intent (while keeping existing structure) so dialogs match the new editor theme and remain mobile-friendly. Use existing shadcn-ui Dialog primitives already referenced here; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the editor screen layout uses a mobile-first structure (safe spacing, scrollable panels where appropriate, no horizontal overflow) and consistent button hierarchy using shadcn-ui components; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
